Acao Criar Indice Hipoteticoni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_CriarIndiceHipotetico

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Criar Indice Hipotetico ni
tem Descricao dp "create hypothetical index % on %(%);"
tem Justificativa dp "Como o índice deixou de ser benéfico para o BD (Benefício: % X Custo de criação: %), decidiu-se por removê-lo e criá-lo apenas na metabase."

Acao Criar Indice Realni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_CriarIndiceReal

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Criar Indice Real ni
tem Descricao dp "create index % on %(%);"
tem Justificativa dp "Índice possui o benefício estimado em %, o que supera o seu custo de criação estimado em %. Comandos que geraram os benefícios: %."

Acao Criar Visao Materializada Realni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_CriarVisaoMaterializadaReal

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Visao Materializada Real ni
foi Executada dp "false"^^boolean
tem Decisao D B A dp "true"^^boolean
tem Descricao dp "create materialized view %"
tem Justificativa dp "A visão materializada hipotética está com benefício positivo estimado de %, o que, em módulo, supera o seu custo de criação estimado em %."

Acao Heuristica Visao Materializada Beneficiosni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_HeuristicaVisaoMaterializadaBeneficios

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Visao Materializada Real ni
foi Executada dp "false"^^boolean
tem Decisao D B A dp "true"^^boolean
tem Descricao dp "HeuristicaVisaoMaterializadaBeneficios"
tem Justificativa dp "Esta visão materializada possui o benefício estimado em <VisaoMaterializada.beneficioAcumulado>, o que supera o seu custo de criação estimado de <VisaoMaterializada.custoCriacao>. Comandos que geraram os benefícios: <VisaoMaterializada.comandosBeneficiados>"

Acao Heuristica Visao Materializada Candidatasni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_HeuristicaVisaoMaterializadaCandidatas

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Visao Materializada Hipotetica ni
foi Executada dp "false"^^boolean
tem Decisao D B A dp "true"^^boolean
tem Descricao dp "HeuristicaVisaoMaterializadaCandidatas"
tem Justificativa dp "A consulta SQL: <Consulta> foi reescrita para torná-la genérica e passível de uso por outras consultas com a mesma estrutura, mas parâmetros diferentes. Como consequência, foi sugerida a visão materializada hipotética com a seguinte sintaxe: <DLL Create View>"

Acao Heuristica Visao Materializada Expectativani back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_HeuristicaVisaoMaterializadaExpectativa

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Visao Materializada Real ni
foi Executada dp "false"^^boolean
tem Decisao D B A dp "true"^^boolean
tem Descricao dp "HeuristicaVisaoMaterializadaExpectativa"
tem Justificativa dp "Esta visão materializada possui o custo estimado de execução de <VisaoMaterializada.custoEstimadoExecucao>, enquanto a consulta original possui o custo de <Consulta.custoExecucao>. Logo, a economia estimada a cada utilização da visão materializada poderá ser de <VisaoMaterializada.ganhoExecucao>"

Acao Remover Indice Hipoteticoni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#Acao_RemoverIndiceHipotetico

belongs to
Acao c
has facts
e Realizada Por op Funcao Remover Indice Hipotetico ni
tem Descricao dp "drop hypothetical index %;"
tem Justificativa dp "Como o índice demonstrou ser benéfico para o BD (Benefício: % X Custo de criação: %), decidiu-se por removê-lo como hipotético e criá-lo como real, fisicamente no BD."

D M L Statement T P C H Q01 Pricing Summary Reportni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q01_PricingSummaryReport

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty, sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge, avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty, avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price, avg(l_discount) as avg_disc, count(*) as count_order from lineitem where l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '90' day group by l_returnflag, l_linestatus order by l_returnflag, l_linestatus;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q02 Minimum Cost Supplierni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q02_MinimumCostSupplier

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment from part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and p_size = 15 and p_type like '%BRASS' and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'EUROPE' and ps_supplycost = (select min(ps_supplycost) from partsupp, supplier, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'EUROPE') order by s_acctbal desc, n_name, s_name, p_partkey;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q03 Shipping Priorityni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q03_ShippingPriority

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select l_orderkey, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority from customer, orders, lineitem where c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' and c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-15' and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-15' group by l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority order by revenue desc, o_orderdate;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q04 Order Priority Checkingni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q04_OrderPriorityChecking

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select o_orderpriority, count(*) as order_count from orders where o_orderdate >= date '1993-07-01' and o_orderdate < date '1993-07-01' + interval '3' month and exists (select * from lineitem where l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate) group by o_orderpriority order by o_orderpriority;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q05 Local Supplier Volumeni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q05_LocalSupplierVolume

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select n_name, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from customer, orders, lineitem, supplier, nation, region where c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_suppkey = s_suppkey and c_nationkey = s_nationkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'ASIA' and o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01' and o_orderdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year group by n_name order by revenue desc;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q06 Forecasting Revenue Changeni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q06_ForecastingRevenueChange

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01' and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year and l_discount between 0.06 - 0.01 and 0.06 + 0.01 and l_quantity < 24;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q07 Volume Shippingni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q07_VolumeShipping

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, sum(volume) as revenue from (select n1.n_name as supp_nation, n2.n_name as cust_nation, extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume from supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2 where s_suppkey = l_suppkey and o_orderkey = l_orderkey and c_custkey = o_custkey and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey and ((n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' and n2.n_name = 'GERMANY') or (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' and n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')) and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31') as shipping group by supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year order by supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q08 National Market Shareni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q08_NationalMarketShare

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select o_year, sum(case when nation = 'BRAZIL' then volume else 0 end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share from (select extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume, n2.n_name as nation from part, supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2, region where p_partkey = l_partkey and s_suppkey = l_suppkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_custkey = c_custkey and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'AMERICA' and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31' and p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL') as all_nations group by o_year order by o_year;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q09 Product Type Profit Measureni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q09_ProductTypeProfitMeasure

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select nation, o_year, sum(amount) as sum_profit from (select n_name as nation, extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount from part, supplier, lineitem, partsupp, orders, nation where s_suppkey = l_suppkey and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey and ps_partkey = l_partkey and p_partkey = l_partkey and o_orderkey = l_orderkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and p_name like '%green%') as profit group by nation, o_year order by nation, o_year desc;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q10 Returned Item Reportingni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q10_ReturnedItemReporting

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select c_custkey, c_name, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment from customer, orders, lineitem, nation where c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate >= date '1993-10-01' and o_orderdate < date '1993-10-01' + interval '3' month and l_returnflag = 'R' and c_nationkey = n_nationkey group by c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment order by revenue desc;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q11 Important Stock Identificationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q11_ImportantStockIdentification

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select ps_partkey, sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) as value from partsupp, supplier, nation where ps_suppkey = s_suppkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_name = 'GERMANY' group by ps_partkey having sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (select sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001000000 from partsupp, supplier, nation where ps_suppkey = s_suppkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_name = 'GERMANY') order by value desc;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q12 Shipping Modes And Order Priorityni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q12_ShippingModesAndOrderPriority

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select l_shipmode, sum(case when o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' then 1 else 0 end) as high_line_count, sum(case when o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' and o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH' then 1 else 0 end) as low_line_count from orders, lineitem where o_orderkey = l_orderkey and l_shipmode in ('MAIL', 'SHIP') and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate and l_shipdate < l_commitdate and l_receiptdate >= date '1994-01-01' and l_receiptdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year group by l_shipmode order by l_shipmode;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q13 Customer Distributionni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q13_CustomerDistribution

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select c_count, count(*) as custdist from (select c_custkey, count(o_orderkey) as c_count from customer left outer join orders on c_custkey = o_custkey and o_comment not like '%special%requests%' group by c_custkey) as c_orders group by c_count order by custdist desc, c_count desc;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q14 Promotion Effectni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q14_PromotionEffect

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select 100.00 * sum(case when p_type like 'PROMO%' then l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) else 0 end) / sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as promo_revenue from lineitem, part where l_partkey = p_partkey and l_shipdate >= date '1995-09-01' and l_shipdate < date '1995-09-01' + interval '1' month;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q15 Top Supplierni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q15_TopSupplier

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "with revenue0 as (select l_suppkey as supplier_no, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as total_revenue from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1996-01-01' and l_shipdate < date '1996-01-01' + interval '3' month group by l_suppkey) select s_suppkey, s_name, s_address, s_phone, total_revenue from supplier, revenue0 where s_suppkey = supplier_no and total_revenue = (select max(total_revenue) from revenue0) order by s_suppkey;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q16 Parts Supplier Relationshipni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q16_PartsSupplierRelationship

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select p_brand, p_type, p_size, count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from partsupp, part where p_partkey = ps_partkey and p_brand <> 'Brand#45' and p_type not like 'MEDIUM POLISHED%' and p_size in (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9) and ps_suppkey not in (select s_suppkey from supplier where s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%') group by p_brand, p_type, p_size order by supplier_cnt desc, p_brand, p_type, p_size;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q17 Small Quantity Order Revenueni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q17_SmallQuantityOrderRevenue

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select sum(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly from lineitem, part where p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#23' and p_container = 'MED BOX' and l_quantity < (select 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) from lineitem where l_partkey = p_partkey);"

D M L Statement T P C H Q18 Large Volume Customerni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q18_LargeVolumeCustomer

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, sum(l_quantity) from customer, orders, lineitem where o_orderkey in (select l_orderkey from lineitem group by l_orderkey having sum(l_quantity) > 314) and c_custkey = o_custkey and o_orderkey = l_orderkey group by c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice order by o_totalprice desc, o_orderdate;"

D M L Statement T P C H Q19 Discounted Revenueni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/OntologiaTuning.owl#DMLStatement_TPCH_Q19_DiscountedRevenue

belongs to
Query Statement c
has facts
tem Descricao dp "select sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from lineitem, part where (p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#12' and p_container in ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') and l_quantity >= 1 and l_quantity <= 1 + 10 and p_size between 1 and 5 and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON') or (p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#23' and p_container in ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') and l_quantity >= 10 and l_quantity <= 10 + 10 and p_size between 1 and 10 and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON') or (p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = 'Brand#34' and p_container in ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') and l_quantity >= 20 and l_quantity <= 20 + 10 and p_size between 1 and 15 and l_shipmode in ('AIR', 'AIR REG') and l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON');"
